entries.claim: The pinned Latin Mass data independently corroborate the component's substantive Latin and expose accidental editorial variants for collation.

Rubricae generales 427 prescribes the Introit antiphon, psalm verse, Gloria Patri and repeated antiphon. Ritus servandus IV 2 also describes the Introit, Gloria Patri and repetition before Kyrie. These same-edition rubrics support the declared common expansion and reprise at w039–w084, not exact reader accidentals or a further independent print witness. The complete proper antiphon and verse remain supported by their own proper-page use.

locator.section: Ordo Missae, Psalmus 42, Gloria Patri and Sicut erat

entries.claim: The same-edition Ordo Missae prints the complete twenty-word Gloria Patri through Amen corresponding to w039–w058. The proper Introit page prints only the Gloria Patri cue. This use supports the common Latin wording, not an Introit performer or exact reader typography; the Ordo colon after semper is a reader comma here.

The cited proper passage prints this Introit’s antiphon and psalm verse, with abbreviated cues for the Gloria Patri and the repeated antiphon. The reader supplies the common doxology and the antiphon’s repetition in full. Those expansions are not printed in full at this locus.
